notes.title: A look back in the past and Looking towards the future!!
notes.notes:
As you may know My store paged launched 2 years ago today! Its been a crazy 2 years with so many big things happening! With 13 Demo updates some smaller update and some bigger ones. I want to show you somethings about the past and where we are now and what's coming in the future!

[h2]2017 Where it all started![/h2]
So I started to game development around 2014 and around 2017 I had a really good start. I really liked the direction I was going. this is a preview of what my game looked like back then. Its crazy to think this was before I didn't know what I was missing.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924597/1867a56f4592d4328b65b17e5fed6c3764fe11dd.png[/img]
Around this time I was working on designing my own weapons for a future game and at that time I didn't think about putting my own weapons in the game. This was before I got a new computer. When I got a new computer i loaded up my project and tried to run it. Nothing worked it crashed on start and It was just impossible to fix. Late 2017 I had restarted my whole project.

[h2]2020 New ideas and direction[/h2]
Now we fast forward 3 years and I got my game to a working state and was really happy with the direction I was going but I wanted to implement Attachments for weapons and I had a little bit of a base line for it but wasn't able to get it to work in the current state. Here is what it looked like in its early state.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924597/e64179fed9fdcdcb2217f4a3bc03d607d1706509.png[/img] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924597/cffb908e3528b42de9d2644bf775c1bb556399b9.png[/img]
so in October I restarted once again but it wasn't completely over I still had good bones I just redid it to look a whole lot different and actually work with what I wanted like weapon attachments.

[h2]2021 to Where we are today[/h2]
A year later I had a lot going for me. I had a lot of cool weapons with weapon attachments and got to the point of having at least 8 weapons working. A lot changed from then to now. we didn't even have all the weapons designed yet but we got that done I kept pushing for a new weapon and kept trying to push for more and bigger things. Now we skipped ahead to June of 2022 this is the month I found out that Steam changed there process from steam greenlight to just getting your game to steam! That is when the whole direction changed and It has turned into what we see today!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924597/9a5fd00a039ee4ccf163f458ce7074bb81e1c89b.png[/img]

[h2]Looking into the future now![/h2]
We are looking into the future of the game. As you may know Chapter 1 is pretty much complete! you may not see this as I lock that down to where you cant! we have been hard at work improving the game and making the necessary changes to make this game Amazing at launch! Chapter 2 is making a lot of progress I would say if I would to work on it for a whole week chapter 2 would be done. Does it mean the launch is soon no it doesn't but as a solo developer I never thought I would be getting to the point of just finalizing the game and that is where we are right now. I cant thank you enough for all of the support you have given and all the people that has helped me on this journey and we still have a long journey ahead to a bright future to this game!

notes.title: Quietus Allurement Demo Update 7: 4K resolution Release!
notes.notes:
As many of you know this update has a lot of changes to it like major improvements and removing the duplicates and redundancies of the game. So updates will be faster to change and will apply to all and not just one game mode or other things. This update has the ability for a higher screen resolutions then just 1920x1080 which is awesome and no more ARROWs.. The arrows in the video settings have been removed! as much as that system worked it was just to the point where it needed to be retired and changed to what it is now. Here is the overall Patch notes of the game which is still heavily being update and more demo updates will be coming!

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
Added: up to 4k resolutions and a new selection feature for all video options.
Added: Options menu now shows more options for controls that are planned for full release of the game. Steam Deck and controller. We are working on controller support in the next patch or two. [b]Down below shows our phases and these will stay on each update to give you a heads up when you might see this happening..[/b]
Added: info page has changed and more pages have been added. [b]Info for these new pages is still work in progress at the moment.[/b]
Added: New Sniper Scope system with zoom. [b]Still work in progress will see more changes to them soon.[/b]
Fixed: Crash with sprinting in chapter 1 level 1.
Fixed: Voicelines in Chapter 1 Level 1 were being skipped.
Fixed: Cursor image was incorrectly displayed in the info screen.
Fixed: Crash with weapon showcase when clicking on sniper rifles
Changed/Optimization: This change isn't going to be noticeable but it will make the options menu a little easier to expand on to the future.
Removed: work in progress on survival menu option.
[h2]Controller Support[/h2]
This will be implemented in three phases.
[h3]Phase 1: [/h3]This phase consists of the main menu phase so anything in menus should be working. Will need more testing to find out for sure!
[h3]Phase 2: [/h3]This phase consists of the full game being able to be played with a controller..
[h3]Phase 3:[/h3] This phase consists of bug fixes. Improvements to overall controller support.

[h2]Survival Changes[/h2]
Removed: info button in survival menu as the info menu on the main menu has all the info needed for both.
Changed: Ground Monsters are now alerted later meaning less range and attack with less range. To allow more time to kill them. Developer Notes I thought this change was better than lowering the damage for now. More changes will be evaluated as time goes on.

notes.title: Devlopment Progress #18 Changes are coming!
notes.notes:
So, it’s been almost two months since the last update and here’s a list of stuff we have been working on.
[h2][b]Sniper Scopes[/b][/h2]
I know this was not working properly in survival mode and I’ve been trying to figure out a new system for this to work better. After a lot of late nights thinking and long days of coding. There’s a new system going into place where its smoother and some surprises will be coming with that. Not only will this system work in story it also works in survival.
[h2][b]Info pages[/b][/h2]
The info pages are being added to the game this area kind of lack in the fact that it was very basic but I’m working on adding this in so we can get closer to finished. So the main focus after finishing these things will be the full game then.
[h2][b]Options Menu Changes[/b][/h2]
These are mainly just code changes but, in the controls, there is going to be changes in the fact that I’m getting prepared to add more options. New options are for Controller and Steam deck. Yes, I’m working towards having my game work with steam deck as much as possible.  I’m also working on getting stuff set up for controller. Support for controller is not there yet but we are working towards that and trying to improve those systems.

As always, I can’t thank you all enough for the support. This is my first game I’m really wanting to release and give to you all and these changes are slow but I’m working as hard as I can do for one person.

notes.title: Development Progress #7 Demo Release Status

Its been really busy during the holidays, so I haven't had time to post but now I have time, I hope everyone had a really merry Christmas and a good happy new years!

Some of you may know that the demo launches In less then one month! The demo will be released on the steam store for the up coming steam next fest! The demo will be skipping level 1 due to it being a tutorial level and the tutorial level is not going to be finished at this time. It might get done before the demo releases but I don't think it will. So the current status of the demo includes
[olist]
[b]Story mode[/b] will have 4-5 levels I say that because there is 5 levels because one of the levels has a different route you can take but only 4 total also you'll face 2 different monster types and 24 total weapons to play with. Every weapon is unlocked.
[b]Survival mode[/b] This mode will not be in at release. being that this has only been in development for less than a year its been a lot of work for a single person to get it working the way I want to. but the demo will be updated as things get developed so when this is ready to go the demo will include 1 map for you to try out! The map currently in development is called Santa's Workshop.

The reason I'm doing steam next fest now is because I feel like the game is at that point of that 20-30 minute demo play and with all the work I've made this year I have a good feeling of trying to release the game either Late this year or early 2024 if all goes well!

notes.title: Development Progress #5 Steam Next Fest Details
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924597/59963c6d3a92883fad9883e6a50797057ff85ebc.jpg[/img]

So the last month I've been preparing for February 2023 [b]Steam Next Fest![/b] The release of the demo is going to be January 26th at 12am CST! The demo will be public at that time mainly for the press review! but you're free to play it but if you want to wait till Steam Next Fest thats fine too!

[h1][b]The Demo Details![/b][/h1]

[b]Story Mode[/b] Hopefully will have the first chapter with voicelines! and the rest wont just because I dont want to give away the whole story in the demo! The demo will have 5-6 levels,

[b]Weapons Available[/b] There will be 24 weapons for you to try and use at any point! Once the full game comes out the weapons will be level locked.

The Demo [u]wont have Survival when it releases on the 26th[/u] but there will be demo updates to improve the game and see how things are working and there will be a survival map that will release with the demo when the survival game mode is at that point where I think is in a good spot for it to be released where there are minimal bugs and that there's just a few things that I have to tweak before the game launches. but once the demo reaches that point of being a completed state it will not get any more updates after that.

notes.title: Development Progress #4 2 Years ago!
notes.notes: We started rebuilding the game from the ground up. With us doing that we were able to add a lot of cool features One of them being profiles but I didn't know getting my game on steam was gonna be possible right away so we removed that. but Maybe in the future it will come back later. possible on a different game or something. The other things we got working are all of the attachments for the weapons and we only had 8 working weapons now we have all 24 weapons. We even had a more levels with improvements to all of the levels. We added a blood system that looks really cool! Lighting system has been improved. We got working progress survival mode. More details coming soon with that later. We still have a lot of work to do on that. This past week I've been programing some things for the first level to get the tutorial mission done. I haven't really worked on much else because I really want to make sure that the code that I'm doing for the first level wont screw up the other levels. The past 2 years have been some of the best years for this game. It has really just made this game so much better. I'm sure as time goes on it will be getting close to release. I'm still hoping sometime in [b]2024 [/b][u]I know that seems like a long ways away but its going to be worth it especially with all the work that I've been putting into the game. [/u]

notes.title: Development Progress #1
notes.notes:
Its been a long time in the works just getting to the point of being able to even have my game tested and actually in a state where It can finally be finished. I'm really liking the progress I've made for the first time in forever. I've been meaning to post something on day one when my store page has been published but I've had so much to do. I'm a one person developing basically the whole game, I have a few testers and a few people lined up to do voice lines.

[b]QNA[/b]

[b]Will it Take till 2024 for release?[/b]
Right now that's what I'm thinking, but I'm gonna try to push it for earlier if possible. I want to make sure that the product that I'm gonna release is to the point of finished state. I want to minimize as many bugs as possible. Since I'm only one person I may have to push the date more but I will know more as time goes on.

[b]What will be the cost of the game[/b]
Right now the price is gonna be $40 us dollars. The reason being is that there's been a lot of work and a lot of content to it. 

[b]Will there be more content later on?[/b] 
If its all going well yes some maybe paid content releases some will be free. I'm thinking about maybe more weapons and more survival maps. Not sure what it all entails yet. I've got a lot to worry about yet and I'm not really thinking about new content at this time.

[b]Current Development progress[/b]
Right now I'm close to releasing a new update to beta testers. Which is a good thing because it's been a bit since the last beta test update. In a few months I'm gonna try and take my time into making a trailer for the game! I wanna get voice lines done before I do create it.


More details will be coming soon! Its been an a journey so far and still got a lot of work to do!
